source: Just released · FTA CTP013 & CTP014 · 27 Nov 2026
headline: TWO 50% OWNERS
CAN'T SHARE

blocks.text: Same two owners, so our companies can move losses between them.

items: **One owner, 75%+:** a single person must hold 75% of both. No adding owners together.
**From day one:** 75% must hold from the start of the loss period to the end of the period it is used.
**New or bought companies:** ownership mid-year can block that year's transfer.
